shots: Shot 1: Morning in Miri’s village. Track alongside Miri as she runs through the lane clutching a cloth bundle, with Nim close at her heels. Nim looks eagerly toward the bundle while Miri keeps moving and answers him. {NIM: Is it bread?} {MIRI: No.} {NIM: Is it meat?} {MIRI: No.} {NIM: Is it bread pretending not to be bread?}

Shot 2: By a low wall in the same morning lane, Miri stops and peeks inside the bundle. Move in close enough to reveal three honey-date cakes, then include Nim beside her as he reacts with delight. {NIM: It is better than bread.}
